translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Bollaa Ittippetetsaa
Hewaa diraw, taani Godaw ootsiyaa diraw k'ashetteeddawe S'oossay hinttena s'eeseedda s'eessaw bessiyaa de'uwaa hintte de'anaadan, taani hinttena woossay.
Ubbaa wode hintte hintte huup'iyaa kawushshiyaawantta, ashikketuwaanne danddayanchchatuwaa gidite; ittuu ittuwaa maaddiyaawaan hintte siik'uwaa bessite.
Hinttena ittippe gatsi k'achchiyaa sarotetsaan, Geeshsha Ayyaanay hinttenttoo immiyaa ittippetetsaa naaganaw minnite.
S'oossay hinttena s'eeseedda hidootay, hintte demmana giide naagi utteeddawe mes's'i ittuwaa gidowaadan, itti asatetsaynne itti Geeshsha Ayyaanay de'ee.
Itti Goday, itti ammanuunne itti s'ink'k'atay de'ee.
Ubbaa Goday, ubbaa baggana ootsiyaawe, ubbaa giddon de'iyaawe, itti S'oossay, ubbaa Aawuu de'ee.
Shin Kiristtoosi immeedda imuwaadan, nuuni huup'iyaan huup'iyaan dumma imuwaa akkeeddo.
Hewaa diraw, S'oossaa Mas'aafay,
yaagee.
Yaatina, «Pude keseedda» giyaawe waagiyaawee? I koyiro duge wod'd'eedda; hewe sa'aw hirkki wurssetsasaa wod'd'eedda giyaawaa.
Ha duge wod'd'eeddawe bare huup'ew Aa; he I ubbabaa kumanaadan, saluwaa ubbaappe d'ok'k'iyaasaa pude keseedda.

Asaw imotaa immeeddawe Aa; I ittuwaa ittuwaa Yesuusi kiitteeddawantta, haratuwaa timbbitiyaa odiyaawantta, k'ay haratuwaa mishiraachchuwaa k'aalaa odiyaawantta, k'aykka haratuwaa woosa golliyaa kaaletsiyaawanttanne tamaarissiyaawantta ootsi suntseedda.
I hewaa geeshshatuu ubbay ammaniyaa asaa oosuwaa ootsanaadaninne Kiristtoosa bollan kees'ettanaadan giigissanaw ootseedda.
K'ay nuuni ubbay S'oossaa Na'aa ammaninanne erina beettiyaa ittippetetsaakko gakkana; nuuni Kiristtoosa polo dichchaa keenaa dic'c'iide, donzza asaa gidanaadaana.
Nuuni beetan yaanne haanne shoc'ettiide, barenttu c'immiyaa hanotaan asaa balaa ogiyaa kaaletsiyaa geniyaa asaa timirttiyaa c'arkkuwaa ubbaan sugettiidde, hawaappe sintsaw na'aa gidanaw bessena.
Shin nuuni siik'otetsan tumuwaa haasayiidde, huup'e gidiyaa Kiristtoosakko ubbabaan dic'c'anaw bessee.

Bollaa giddon de'iyaa dumma dumma shaakotay aan ittippe oyk'etteeddino; k'ay kumentsaa bollay barew imetteeddasaa ubbaan ittuu ittuwaanna gakettiide, ittippe oyk'k'etti utteedda; he dumma dumma shaakotay ootsanaw bessiyaawaa ootsiyaa wode, kumentsaa bollay siik'uwaan dic'c'eenne barena kees's'ee.
Kiristtoosan Beettiyaa Ooratsa De'uwaa
Hewaa diraw, taani hawaa hinttenttoo Godaa suntsan odaynne markkattay. Hintte go"i bayinna k'ofaa k'oppiyaa Ayihuda gidenna asatuwaadan de'oppite.
Unttunttu wozanay d'umaan de'ee; unttunttu ayinne erennawanttanne azazettena diraw, S'oossay immiyaa de'uwaappe haakkeeddino.
Unttunttu matan yeella giyaawe baawa; unttunttu woshummaw kajjeelanaw barenttu huup'iyaa aatsi immiino; k'ay tunabaa ubbaa pac'i bayinnaan ootsanaw loytsi yorattiyaawantta.
Shin hintte Kiristtoosawaa hewaadan tamaaribeykkita.
Aabaa tumu siseeddita; k'ay tumatetsaykka Yesuusan de'iyaawaa, aappe tamaareeddita.
Hintte kase de'iyaa de'uwaa aggite; k'ay bare c'immiyaa amuwaan d'ayiyaa hintte ec'a asatetsaa d'ayissite.
Hintte wozanaynne k'ofay ubbaanna ooras's'anaw bessee.
Tumu s'illotetsaaninne geeshshatetsaan S'oossaa leemisuwaan med'etteedda ooratsa asatetsaa mayyite.
Simmi worddotoppite. Nuuni ubbay Kiristtoosa asatetsan itti asaa gidiyaa diraw, Asay ubbay bare ishaw tumuwaa haasayanaw bessee.
Hank'k'ettite; shin hintte hank'k'uwaan nagaraa ootsoppite. Hintte hank'k'uwaan de'ishshin, away wulloppo.
S'alahew s'oo'iyaa immoppite.
Wuu"iyaa uray hawaappe sintsaw wuu"oppo; shin hewaa aggiide, hiyyeesatuwaa maaddanaw, bare kushiyan lo"obaa ootsiidde daaburo.
Hintte haasayay sisiyaawantta go"ana mala, koshshiyaawaadan mentsetsiyaa lo"o k'aalay hintte doonaappe kesoppe attin, iita k'aalay mulekka kesoppo.
S'oossay hinttena woziyaa gallassaw hintte attametti utteedda S'oossaa Geeshsha Ayaanaa kayyoyoppite.
Is's'iyaa hanotaa, yiluwaa, hank'k'uwaa, waasuwaanne c'ashshaa ubbaa iitatetsaa ubbaanna hintteppe d'ayissite.
Ittuu ittoo keekitenne k'arettite; k'ay S'oossay Kiristtoosa baggana hinttenttoo atto geeddawaadan, hinttekka ittuu ittuwaa atto giite.
